permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation.
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit number and Registration No. both shown as 52432 on cover/authorization pages. Issuance date from 'Approved on July 7, 2025.' Facility address appears in multiple forms ('Pkwy' vs 'Parkway', with/without city/zip); used the address line from the authorization block. Startup notifications include both anticipated (postmarked not more than 60 days nor less than 30 days) and actual (within 15 days); startupNotificationWindowDays reflects the 15-day actual startup notification.

generatorSets.extractionNotes: Grouping, make/model, and capacities from Equipment List table under 'Equipment included in the project'. Model given as 'Model C3000D6EB (QSK78-36)'; captured first explicitly named model. Control technology and hour meter requirements from Conditions 1 and 3 (apply to EG-2-01 through EG-2-31). Fuel, grade, spec, sulfur, certification, and change trigger from Conditions 8 and 9. Fuel throughput combined limit from Condition 7. Allowed operating modes from Condition 5. Visible emissions limit from Condition 15 (10% opacity with one six-minute period per hour up to 20%). NSPS IIII and MACT ZZZZ applicability stated in the cover letter.
